name: Wiener Apartments
address: Little Banyan Road North - Wiener Apartments
desc: Wiener Apartments – Smart Living by Leon Estate Group. A practical, loft-style apartment right next to the city's bustling commercial street. Designed for comfort and value, the open layout makes the most of your space while meeting everyday needs with ease. Fully equipped with essential home appliances—just move in and start living. Whether you're shopping, dining, or just enjoying city life, it's all just steps away. Wiener Apartments offer the perfect launchpad for your next chapter in modern urban living.

name: Eden Apartments
slogan: Turning every day into a vacation!
desc: One of the high-end apartments under Leon Estate Group, premium housing in Bridge Crossings. Prime location, complete facilities, personalized design, and a panoramic city view. The place comes with an exclusive anomaly butler to manage all aspects of your life. Whether you're here to host a party or for private leisure, this place is sure to meet all of your expectations for a quality life!

name: Skyview Halls
slogan: Make Hethereau Skytower your exclusive home decor!
address: Crocodile Clock Avenue North - Skyview Halls 21F
desc: Skyview Halls—Leon Estate Group's premium apartment selection—is situated in the heart of Miguel District's commercial hub, within view of the iconic Hethereau Skytower. Featuring full premium decorations that create spacious, bright living areas, it redefines the concept of villa living in a flat layout. The exceptional space efficiency ensures value in every square inch, while the unobstructed design welcomes natural light and scenic views year-round. With diverse commercial amenities within walking distance, it perfectly accommodates quality lifestyle needs including pet care, dining, and cultural activities.

name: Golden Capital
slogan: Ascend to the city's peak and enjoy the ultimate panoramic views!
address: Center Crystal Mountain Avenue - Golden Capital 27F
desc: Golden Capital—Leon Estate Group's premium apartment selection—is located in the heart of New Herland. Golden Capital meticulously crafts elegant high-rise living spaces with open and spacious layouts that embody sophisticated urban living. With elevators providing direct access to Kyllene Promenade, residents can immerse themselves in New Herland's trendiest offerings, while the surrounding major arteries of Camelot and Keno Boulevards place the splendor of Hethereau's metropolitan landscape just steps away.

name: Stillmeadow House
desc: A modern take on country living, blending smart home comforts with a landscaped courtyard to create an elegant escape from city life for both body and mind.

name: Pegasus Residence
slogan: Luxury living, with your beloved car by your side!
desc: A landmark work by one of Hethereau's renowned commissioned designers, Pegasus Residence occupies the building's top floor. This meticulously crafted penthouse duplex features a sweeping fan-shaped layout, panoramic city views, and a private open-air pool, inviting you to enjoy a refined lifestyle above the clouds. Inside, an original sky garage is directly accessible by automotive elevator, giving your beloved car a place of honor and creating an avant-garde living experience where driver and machine coexist.

name: Fenglin Villa
slogan: Claim your very own sanctuary in the woods!
desc: Fenglin Villa, Leon Estate Group's flagship luxury villa. Stands proudly at the highest point of Green Wall Slope. Featuring an open-concept layout with spacious, magnificent design, Fenglin Villa allows you to enjoy life with effortless elegance. Floor-to-ceiling windows capture the full splendor of Green Wall Slope's seasons, while the master bedroom on the top floor offers exclusive views of Hethereau's unique skyline. The villa comes equipped with an oversized above-ground Garage and a resort-level outdoor swimming pool, perfectly delivering on every aspect of what you imagine "luxury" to be.
